summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zenith Oracle astrology platform upgrade. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified Oracle Feed component, Pancha-Pakshi card, Nakshatra Padas, and design styling. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: OracleFeed.js line 29: React Hook useEffect has missing dependency 'fetchPanchaPakshi' - minor ESLint warning, not blocking functionality
test_credentials: No auth required for this app
seed_data_creation: None - app uses real Swiss Ephemeris calculations
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (GET /api/oracle-feed, POST /api/vedic/pancha-pakshi, GET /api/vedic/nakshatra-padas) are working correctly. Oracle Feed component loads on Dashboard with COSMIC INTELLIGENCE header, live ticker with Nakshatra Pada info, and three tabs (Transit Alerts, Collective Energy, Historical). Pancha-Pakshi card appears after submitting birth details showing birth bird, current state, power level, and strategic guidance. Design uses Obsidian Glass (#020617) background with gold (#D4AF37) borders. Redis cache is disconnected (expected) - endpoints calculate fresh data.

backend_endpoints.GET /api/oracle-feed: Returns transit_alerts, psychic_update, historical_parallels, current_transits with proper structure
backend_endpoints.POST /api/vedic/pancha-pakshi: Returns birth_bird, current_state, power_level, nakshatra_pada with proper structure
backend_endpoints.GET /api/vedic/nakshatra-padas: Returns Moon's current Nakshatra Pada with moon_longitude, moon_sign, nakshatra_detail, moon_phase, tithi

frontend_components.Oracle Feed: Loads on Dashboard with COSMIC INTELLIGENCE header, THE TIDES OF TIME subtitle, Live indicator
frontend_components.Transit Ticker: Shows planetary positions with Nakshatra Pada info (e.g., 'Pisces 15.7 | Uttara Bhadrapada P4 | Moon Leo 16.8 | Purva Phalguni P2')
frontend_components.Transit Alerts Tab: Shows real planetary data including aspects and Moon Nakshatra Pada alerts
frontend_components.Collective Energy Tab: Shows moon phase, energy rating (0-100), quality, and guidance
frontend_components.Historical Tab: Shows Saturn and Jupiter historical parallels with strategic/ancient tone
frontend_components.Pancha-Pakshi Card: Appears after birth details submission, shows bird name (Sanskrit), current state, power level, Nakshatra Pada, strategic guidance, all 5 birds status

design_styling.Gold Borders: #D4AF37 borders on Oracle Feed and cards confirmed
design_styling.Strategic Tone: Phrases like 'The Tides of Time', 'Celestial Alignment', 'Invoke the Oracle' present
